reran.zh: 已从原位置重跑这一轮
reran.en: The turn is running again from its original position

deleted.zh: 已删除此轮并回到对应历史位置
deleted.en: The turn was removed and the conversation returned to that position

running.zh: 这一轮还在进行，等它停下再改
running.en: The turn is still running; wait for it to stop

rewound.en: The message is back in the composer

sent.zh: 已从原消息位置重新发出
sent.en: Sent again from the original message position

failed.en: The message could not be handled

rewindPeerNote.zh: 撤回、编辑、重跑与删除由插件 dsh-rewind 提供
rewindPeerNote.en: Retract, edit, rerun and delete come from the dsh-rewind plugin

rewindCheckpointsDesc.zh: 每轮对话前记录工作区快照，供消息回退时同步恢复文件改动。
rewindCheckpointsDesc.en: Snapshot the workspace before each turn so file changes can be restored on rewind.

rewindStorageLimitDesc.zh: 超出上限时自动清理最旧的检查点；超过 16 MB 的单个文件不纳入快照。
rewindStorageLimitDesc.en: Automatically prunes the oldest checkpoints above this cap; individual files over 16 MB are skipped.

rewindStorageDirDesc.zh: 留空使用默认目录，或填写绝对路径存放在其他磁盘。
rewindStorageDirDesc.en: Leave blank for the default directory, or enter an absolute path on another drive.

rewindDescriptionOne.zh: 将从当前时间线移除此轮对话，原会话保留在版本历史中。
rewindDescriptionOne.en: This removes this turn from the current timeline. The source remains in revision history.

rewindDescription.zh: 将从当前时间线移除从这里开始的 {count} 轮对话，原会话保留在版本历史中。
rewindDescription.en: This removes the {count} turns starting here from the current timeline. The source remains in revision history.

restoreFilesOne.zh: 同时恢复代码改动（1 个文件）
restoreFilesOne.en: Restore code changes as well (1 file)

restoreFiles.zh: 同时恢复代码改动（{count} 个文件）
restoreFiles.en: Restore code changes as well ({count} files)

checkpointUnavailable.zh: 无法恢复代码：{reason}。仍可只回退消息。
checkpointUnavailable.en: Code cannot be restored: {reason}. You can still rewind the messages alone.

reasonMissingTarget.en: no checkpoint was recorded for the target turn

reasonIncompleteLater.zh: 部分后续轮次缺少完整检查点
reasonIncompleteLater.en: a subsequent turn is missing a complete checkpoint

reasonUnrestorableFiles.zh: 检查点包含无法恢复的文件
reasonUnrestorableFiles.en: the checkpoint contains files that cannot be restored

reasonWorkspaceMoved.zh: 后续轮次的工作目录发生了变化
reasonWorkspaceMoved.en: the workspace directory changed in a later turn

reasonDirtyFilesExceeded.zh: 工作区变更文件数超出上限（{count} > {limit}）
reasonDirtyFilesExceeded.en: modified workspace files exceeded the limit ({count} > {limit})

reasonSnapshotSizeExceeded.zh: 单次快照体积超出上限（>{limit} MB）
reasonSnapshotSizeExceeded.en: snapshot size exceeded the limit (>{limit} MB)

rewindSideEffects.zh: Git 提交、外部服务与命令产生的其他副作用不会自动撤销。
rewindSideEffects.en: Git commits, external services and other command side effects are not undone.

historyDescription.zh: 切换旧版本不会删除现有对话记录。
historyDescription.en: Opening a previous revision keeps all existing conversation history intact.
